verses.15: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
verses.16: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.17: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.18: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
verses.19: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
verses.20: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
verses.21: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
verses.23: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.24: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.25: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.26: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.27: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
verses.28: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
